<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def eyes(f):
    lines=f.ascii.split('\n')
    sc=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if lines[r][c]=='S']
    cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in sc)); rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in sc))
    left=[c for c in cs if c<32]; right=[c for c in cs if c>=32]
    return (min(rs),max(rs), (min(left),max(left)), (min(right),max(right)))
def bars(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return (sum(1 for c in range(64) if L[0][c]=='B'), sum(1 for c in range(64) if L[63][c]=='B'))
print("start:", eyes(current_frame), "bars:", bars(current_frame))

print("RIGHT1:", eyes(current_frame), "bars:", bars(current_frame), {k:r1[k] for k in ('no_impact','done','level_completed','game_over')})
r2=action(['RIGHT'],intent='explore')
print("RIGHT2:", eyes(current_frame), "bars:", bars(current_frame), {k:r2[k] for k in ('no_impact','done','level_completed','game_over')})
</parameter>

def eyes(f):
    lines=f.ascii.split('\n')
    sc=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if lines[r][c]=='S']
    cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in sc)); rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in sc))
    left=[c for c in cs if c<32]; right=[c for c in cs if c>=32]
    return (min(rs),max(rs), (min(left),max(left)), (min(right),max(right)))
def bars(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return (sum(1 for c in range(64) if L[0][c]=='B'), sum(1 for c in range(64) if L[63][c]=='B'))
